findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal from command-line arguments
 * @description Using command-line arguments in file operations without validation can lead to path traversal
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal-cli
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("argparse").getMember("ArgumentParser").getReturn().getMember("parse_args").getACall() and
      source = call
    ) or
    exists(DataFlow::Node argv |
      argv = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource() and
      source = argv
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(FileSystemAccess fa).getAPathArgument()
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "command-line argument"
findings.hypothesis: Command-line arguments used in file operations without proper validation could allow path traversal attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
 * @description Making HTTP requests with user-controlled URLs can lead to SSRF
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssrf
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SSRFConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getMember("get").getACall() and
      source = call
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("Request").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("http").getMember("client").getMember("HTTPConnection").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("http").getMember("client").getMember("HTTPSConnection").getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SSRFFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SSRFConfig>;
import SSRFFlow::PathGraph

from SSRFFlow::PathNode source, SSRFFlow::PathNode sink
where SSRFFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "SSRF from $@.", source.getNode(), "user-controlled URL"
findings.hypothesis: Check for Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerabilities where user-controlled URLs are used in HTTP requests

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ZIP slip vulnerability
 * @description Extracting ZIP files without validating paths can lead to arbitrary file writes
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/zip-slip
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["open", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  ) and
  // Check if there's no path validation before extraction
  not exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode pathCheck |
    pathCheck.getLocation().getFile() = call.getLocation().getFile() and
    pathCheck.getLocation().getStartLine() < call.getLocation().getStartLine() and
    (
      pathCheck = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["abspath", "realpath", "normpath"]).getACall() or
      pathCheck.getAQlClass() = "CallNode" and
      pathCheck.asExpr().(Call).getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["startswith", "is_relative_to"]
    )
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe archive extraction without path validation - may be vulnerable to ZIP slip."
findings.hypothesis: ZIP files or tar archives extracted without validating member paths could allow writing files outside the intended directory

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Symlink following vulnerability
 * @description Following symlinks without validation can lead to unauthorized file access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/symlink-following
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-59
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["symlink", "link", "readlink"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["symlink_to", "readlink"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["copy", "copy2", "copytree"]).getACall()
  ) and
  not exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode followCheck |
    followCheck = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("islink").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential symlink following vulnerability - symlink operations without proper validation."
findings.hypothesis: Symlink operations without proper validation could lead to symlink attacks
